title: Screen Recorder Unlimited
summary: Simple & Lightweight Screen Recorder app, no watermark, no root, no limits
description:
Lightweight & simple. Screen Recorder Unlimited allow you to recorder your screen without limitation.

Recordings can be in Full HD. Record your games, video calls, even audio sound. Capture your screen with ease.

Features:
- Bubble button overlay appear on top
- Simple user interface, easily record with 1-tap
- Internal Audio option to record only current app's audio
- Microphone recording
- No watermark
- Record gameplay on your phone or tablet
- Screen record with or without sound audio
- No phone rooting 
- No time limit
- Resolution up to 1080p full HD
- Frame per second up to 60 fps
- Adjustable quality up to 12MB/sec

Our app lets you easily record your screen with just a few taps, making it perfect for creating tutorials, sharing gameplay footage, or capturing important moments. With high-quality video and audio recording, you can be sure that every detail is captured in stunning clarity. Plus, our app is packed with features to make your recording experience even better. Whether you're a content creator, gamer, or just need to capture your screen for work or personal use, our app has got you covered. Download now and start recording like a pro!
